禾田屋.note: Good, but not as good as 海賊 (also on this list)!

斌果古早味小吃.note: Braised chicken rice! The boss is really nice.

懂吃懂吃.note: Really good! Nothing bad on the menu. Often a queue.

無名當歸藥燉排骨 羊肉湯.note: The braised pork rice! The best one!

添盛麵館.note: Good: cheap, with lots of toppings.

成功 62.note: The signature dry-mixed noodles are great.

宋朝.note: Not bad, but not worth a special trip.

一品香串燒.note: Very tasty: spicy, salty and sweet! Sadly no pickled-chili pork.

古早味食堂.note: The Shantou dry noodles are good, but taste a bit of vinegar.

享烤串燒.note: Favorite: the pork with pickled chili peppers!

亞美豆漿.note: Steamed bun with meat and egg!

秋香鵝肉.note: You have to order the fried egg! Amazingly good!

玖伍 牛肉麵.note: The zhajiang noodles were bad, but the noodles themselves are good. Try other dishes.

川畝園麵食館.note: The zhajiang noodles were so-so. Try other dishes.

潭村台南虱目魚.note: Braised pork rice and oyster omelette.

葉記陳師父港式燒臘.note: Tastes fine, but NT$110 for a tiny amount of meat.

赤峰街小吃鋪.note: Super big portions, but I didn't like the taste. Good noodles.

八八咖啡店 Haha Café.note: The butter chicken is alright, just not flavorful enough.

虹越小館越南美食.note: OMG, why didn't I try this sooner?! Sooo good!

Ma C So Yo 築夢韓食.note: Fried chicken, rice cakes, black bean noodles.

紅磡新飲茶.note: Good! Love the beef hor fun.

焗工房.note: Good cheap food, big portions, lots of choice.

忠青商行.note: I personally hate it, but Taiwanese people seem to love it?

Gatsby Plus.note: The pasta (the fried chicken one) is good! The burger is just OK.

韓華園.note: Black bean noodles and sweet and sour pork.

Vital 維都.note: The steak pasta was so good. Small portions, and pricey.

喫飯食堂.note: So good! The lard rice! Like a fancier stir-fry place. Nothing bad on the menu.

Sivara 泰國船面.note: Long wait, quite expensive, and you have to order a drink.

台南意麵.note: The braised chicken rice was meh.

一級排骨.note: Bento. Tried the honey chicken, it was OK.

鳳城燒臘家.note: The beef chow fun was meh, but a huge portion. Long wait.

山珍海味台式自助餐.note: Good! Tomato and egg, cabbage, sweet and sour chicken.

熊一頂級燒肉.note: A good buffet that isn't expensive.

海賊日式料理.note: Sooo good, but it often closes early. The 海賊 roll is my favorite.

猴子燒肉.note: Not great value for the price.

Fa Burger.note: One order is enough for two meals! Mild flavors, and tasty.

烤雞特攻隊.note: Amazing! Hard to get: you order through LINE.

Peppino.note: The white-sauce pizza and the prosciutto pizza are delicious!

秋田義大利麵.note: Tasty! The free soup and bread are good too.

聚鍋.note: The milk hot pot is great.

老乾杯.note: Expensive. Good and high quality, but for the taste, 屋馬 is good enough for me.

王艇長炸醬麵.hours: 11:10 AM–2 PM, 5–8:30 PM. Sundays until 3 PM.

Uncle Ray 串燒.note: Not as good as before? The pickled-chili one is my favorite.

阿明港式.note: Sweet and sour pork, fried rice noodles, fried rice!

牛肉麵雞湯.note: Tasty, but the queue is often long.

品都串燒.note: Very juicy and flavorful, but not sweet (I like sweet).

桂客鐵板燒.note: My first teppanyaki. Not a fan, because of the pepper.

魚池壹貳.note: Mango milk, and honey pineapple green tea.

Coco.note: Tried the peach tea, just OK.

甘蔗媽媽.note: Taro milk: thick, but the flavor is weird.

春芳號.note: Get the 淘氣愛妃 with less ice and 80% sugar.

大苑子.note: The mango slush is amazing. Get 70% sugar!

Cows rock.note: Mint chocolate is great. You can tell they care.

Snow factory.note: The yogurt is OK, but the place feels like an MLM.

美味派 Delicious Pie.note: Cheap: about NT$40. The bread has crust.

露西早餐.note: Pricier: about NT$60 for a sandwich, but more bacon, and they press the sides.

朝柴.note: Spicy pickled radish! Meat and egg toast.

快樂堡.note: Great black tea, and the egg crepe is tasty!

早餐小島.note: The best milk-butter toast in the world. Everything else is so-so.

陽光早午餐.note: Iron-plate noodles! The pork chop club sandwich is super good.

早安 微笑.note: The fried instant noodles are OK, and the black tea is good too.

阿雪早餐.note: Good toast, but the quality is up and down.

早湾.note: The rice-noodle egg crepe isn't too thick.
